description: A deterministically failing process-backed tool (`cat` on a path that never exists) retries like any other tool failure (non-HTTP-family, always retryable) -- `meta.retries_used: 1` once both attempts of a `max_attempts: 2` policy fail, absorbed by `on_error: continue`. Uses a real allowlisted binary rather than a case-local fake, so its own resolved path (a stable system path, e.g. `/bin/cat`) never needs redaction the way a per-checkout fakes/ path would.
